subject: Aligning Demo Day — final slot, runbook & split tracks
messages:
From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@allegrasys.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning our enablement — initial availability

Hi Camila / Ben,

Thanks for the quick outreach. We’re keen to get a joint console + API enablement for our platform team. Ideally sometime next week — our goals are: walkthrough of Console admin flows, API key provisioning, and a short integration lab (30–45m).

Our constraints: 1) Exec review on 11/09 blocks the PMs in the afternoon, 2) engineering lead (Victor) is only available mornings PST, and 3) we’d like a split day if possible (console first, API later).

Availability (PST):
- 11/08: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- 11/10: 09:00–13:00 (best)

Attendees: Emma Hayes (Product), Victor Ramirez (Eng), Sara Collins (Security) — Sara may join for the API key/KMS section.

Can you confirm a firm slot and any prep we should share?

Thanks,
Emma
Senior Product Manager
Allegra Systems

Attachments: none
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@allegrasys.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning our enablement — initial availability

Hi Emma — great to hear. We can absolutely do a split-day format (console AM, API PM + hands-on lab). Proposed plan: 09:00–12:00 PST console walkthrough (30m admin + 60m demo + 30m Q&A) then 13:00–15:00 PST API deep-dive and integration lab.

Option slots (PST):
A) 11/08 — Console 09:00–12:00 / API 13:00–15:00
B) 11/10 — Console 09:00–12:00 / API 13:00–15:00 (recommended given your note)
C) 11/13 — same split for extra lead time

I’m attaching our latest runbook (redwood_runbook_v2.pdf) and an ops doc that outlines who presents each segment (console vs API). If 11/10 works, we’ll lock it and send a calendar invite + Zoom link.

Also looping Jordan who will run the integration lab; Ben — would you and Jordan be available to lead the API section on 11/10?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_runbook_v2.pdf (pdf), console-api-split-track-ops.docx (docx)
From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@allegrasys.com>

Date: 2028-11-04T10:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning our enablement — initial availability

Thanks Camila — 11/10 is our preference. One ask: our Head of Engineering has a standing call at 13:00 PST on Fridays that might creep into the API block. Would you be able to shift the API portion earlier same day (12:30–14:30) so Victor can join the start of the lab? If not possible, we can keep 11/08 as a fallback.

Also, Sara will require a short security-focused agenda item on data retention and key rotation (15m). Can you add that into the API section?

Attendees updated: Emma, Victor, Sara Collins

Thanks — confirm and we’ll get calendar hold placed from our side.

Join Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar invite: calendar_invite_20281110.ics (attached)
Agenda highlights:
- 09:00–09:30 Console: admin & tenant setup
- 09:30–10:30 Console: live walkthrough (routes, models, routing policies)
- 10:30–11:00 Console: Q&A + checklist handoff
- 12:30–13:15 API: key provisioning, KMS integration (Ben — 15m on rotation/retention)
- 13:15–14:30 API: integration lab (Jordan leads) + wrap

Prep items for your team:
- Please share an example production prompt set and a representative request volume (tokens/sec) so we can tailor the batching/quantization notes in the lab.
